note.question: How can early reservation support follow-up appointments?
note.overview: In the context of outpatient care, physicians often decide at the end of a consultation session whether to schedule follow-up appointments for patients with likely future needs. Those appointments are referred to as prioritized follow-up (PFU) appointments. This paper studies mechanisms that encourage physicians to schedule the optimal quantity of PFUs, aiming to enhance continuity of care (COC), minimizing no-shows and late cancellations.
